name: Motor-Driven Cycle
description: A light motorcycle with an engine of more than 50 cc but not more than 150 cc, or a motor of not more than five brake horsepower (3,730 W); an electric two-wheeler over the e-bike limits without pedals, or too fast to be a moped, lands here when its motor is within that limit. Defined by West Virginia Code §17C-1-5, unchanged since 2002.
restrictions: A motorcycle: a seat or saddle and no more than three wheels
Its motor produces not more than five brake horsepower (3,730 W)
Riders need a motorcycle license, a license with a motorcycle (F) endorsement, or a motorcycle instruction permit
Every rider and passenger must wear a fastened helmet meeting FMVSS 218, ANSI Z90.1 or Snell standards
Every rider and passenger must wear shatter-resistant safety glasses, goggles or a face shield
Handlebars or grips may be no more than 15 inches above the seat, and it needs a handlebar or fairing mirror showing 200 feet behind
